# SchemaCraft AI

> Real-Time AI Search Visibility Auditor, Technical SEO Diagnostics & Context-Aware Schema.org Generator.

## About SchemaCraft AI
SchemaCraft AI (https://schemacraft-ai.site) is a deterministic audit platform designed to analyze, score, and optimize websites for traditional search engines (Google, Bing) and next-generation Generative AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini).

## Key Diagnostic Modules
- **Technical SEO & Canonical Audits**: Indexability gates, HTTP headers, canonical URL integrity, redirect chains, mobile viewport compliance.
- **Crawlability & AI Bot Directives**: Robots.txt verification for standard web crawlers and AI search agents (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended).
- **Content Answerability & Structure (BLUF)**: Primary heading (H1) detection, lead section density, meta descriptions, FAQ extraction.
- **Entity & Schema.org Graph Diagnostics**: JSON-LD semantic structured data extraction, entity relation graphs, missing rich snippet opportunities.
- **AI Search Opportunity Matrix**: Custom prompt and query visibility analysis, predictive search triggers.

## Platform-Specific Remediation Engines
- **Next.js 15 App Router**: TypeScript metadata exports, dynamic JSON-LD injection, server sitemaps (`app/sitemap.ts`), and security headers.
- **WordPress**: Functions.php hooks, wp_head schema filters, RankMath/Yoast integrations, `.htaccess` caching rules.
- **Shopify**: Liquid theme templates (`theme.liquid`), JSON-LD product/collection schemas, CDN bypasses.
